text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I enter the cafeteria, I notice
Sakura Bakushin O sitting
before a
gigantic mountain of food with a sparkle in
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This food will be gone before you know
it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't my observant trainer! Have
you come to witness my
historic
achievement firsthand?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, you've got FANTASTIC timing! I was
just about to start
practicing for the real
deal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, have a seat! You can watch me
conquer yet another
obstacle on the road
to GLORY!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fear not, Trainer! I'll Bakushin blast this
challenge into oblivion—and
soar to
VICTORY!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The class representative before you will
never bring you shame!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from her statement, there seems
to be some sort of
food-based challenge
at Tracen Academy, and she's planning to

enter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I must beat this challenge! Only then can I
become the TRUE model
class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My opponents; one eggstra large omelet rice, a serving of fried chicken that would make anyone bawk, and a house salad big enough to feed a whole mansion!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
First up, my absolute favorite—MEAT! I'll
down these bad birds at
Baw-kushin
speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
After that, I'll start on the omelet rice!
Always an eggcellent idea to
follow
protein with carbs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And at the tip of the iceberg, we have the salad! It's just a boring salad, so I'll save it for last!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And now all that's left is to... EAT!
Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hold my tongue as I watch Sakura
Bakushin O push aside the
least-filling
dish, the salad, in favor of the heavy fried
chicken...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phew... Okay, time for a break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mountain of food before her barely
has a dent in it. Which...
makes sense,
seeing as she started with the fried foods
and
carbohydrates.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I eat, there's still so
much food... Are these
magical plates that
keep adding more food as I eat?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, your magical sabotage will not
hinder me! I'm a class
representative, and a
class representative never gives up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will overcome this challenge and show all
Umamusume that they can
do ANYTHING
if they put their minds to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's taking this pretty seriously, so I
decide to offer up some advice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y-you do?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is there really a way for me to get faster, even when it comes to eating?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer! Tell me so I can dominate
this food challenge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that fried foods and
carbohydrates fill the stomach quicker,
so
it's best to start with the less-filling
vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Adding that eating the same thing for a
long time could be boring, I
also suggest
sampling a little bit of everything along
the way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, a wise suggestion as always...
Thank you! In that case, I'll
make sure to
cram a little bit of everything in each bite!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fear not, the class representative will
never fail you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, she eagerly returns to her food.
But before long...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin... Baku... shiii—mmph!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: M-my poor jaw... I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... My cute little mouth wasn't ready
for the carnage I subjected
it to...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Just talking hurts... I can't go on...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer... the rest... is up to you... Blech.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Sakura Bakushin O lays down in a
food-induced coma, I pick up my
utensils
and begin my futile effort to finish what
she started.
